Bill.BriefDescription: Allowing certain cities to designate aquifer conservation zones.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to aquifer conservation zones in qualifying islandcities without access to potable water sources outside theirjurisdiction; and adding a new section to chapter 36.70A RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 36.70A RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Any city coterminous with, and comprised only of, an islandthat does not have access to a potable water source outside itsjurisdiction may designate one or more aquifer conservation zones. Aquifer conservation zones may only be designated for the purposeof conserving and protecting potable water sources and may not includethe entirety of a jurisdiction. (2) Aquifer conservation zones may not be considered critical areasunder this chapter except to the extent that specific areas locatedwithin aquifer conservation zones qualify for critical area designationand have been designated as such under RCW 36.70A.060(2). (3) Any city declaring one or more aquifer conservation zones underthis section may determine residential densities within the p. 1 HB 1135conservation zones that, in combination with other densities of thecity, are sufficient to accommodate projected population growth underRCW 36.70A.110. (4) Nothing in this section may be construed to modify thepopulation accommodation obligations required of jurisdictions underthis chapter.
